biography: Dan de Zille, a name now whispered with a mix of respect and trepidation in Formula Trainer circuits, wasn't born into racing royalty. Hailing from a small industrial town in Northern England, his racing journey began with go-karting at a local track cobbled together from spare parts. His early years were defined by a relentless drive, often pushing his equipment and himself to the absolute limit. One defining moment came at the Regional Karting Championship where, despite starting last due to a qualifying mishap, he clawed his way to victory with a daring last-lap overtake that left seasoned veterans stunned. That raw talent and aggressive spirit earned him a spot in the Formula Trainer series. After a shaky start, de Zille found his stride, showcasing incredible pace and racecraft. Now at the peak of his powers, driving for F.Scomasson Skin in the Formula Trainer A series, de Zille is a force to be reckoned with, hungry for championships and unafraid to challenge anyone who stands in his path.
drivingStyle: De Zille's driving style is as aggressive as his personality suggests. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers, often diving into corners where others dare not tread. Tire management isn't his strongest suit; he tends to push hard from the start, sacrificing long-run pace for early gains. Under pressure, de Zille thrives; the more intense the battle, the sharper his focus becomes. He’s a master of exploiting any weakness in his opponents, and he's not afraid to use every inch of the track to gain an advantage.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles – Bellini's smooth, calculated approach clashes with de Zille's aggressive, risk-taking nature, leading to frequent on-track altercations.

rivalries.name: Anya Petrova
rivalries.reason: Petrova and de Zille fought tooth and nail for the Formula Trainer championship, resulting in several controversial incidents and a simmering resentment.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka's unwavering sportsmanship contrasts sharply with de Zille's 'win at all costs' mentality, creating friction both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, no matter how worn they become.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track ('The Ripper') immediately before every race.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Regional Karting Championship from last place after a mechanical failure in qualifying. It proved his determination and skill, opening doors to bigger opportunities.
careerLowPoint: Spinning out of the lead in the final lap of the 2022 Formula Trainer A championship decider due to pushing too hard on worn tires, handing the title to his rival, Marco Bellini.
